name: Muzli
summary: Design inspiration hub that turns every browser new tab into a feed curated from 200+ design sources.
description: Muzli replaces the browser's new tab with a personalised design inspiration feed, blending 200+ design sources with hand-picked editorial selections. Free extension for Chrome, Edge, Safari and Firefox, plus Muzli Web, search across indexed design work, curated collections, the Muzli Colors palette generator, designer profiles and a design jobs board.
